notes:
Account overview: Lighthouse Portfolio runs a subscription-style research portal used by 4 major wealth managers. Primary pain: slow search for time-sensitive research and escalating costs with current vector store. They want a production-grade RAG search stack with embeddings + reranking and strict data residency/KMS controls.

Indexing & scale: customer estimates 200M documents (50M unique research notes + 150M derived passages) => ~500M vectors after passageing. Current POC target: ingest 30M docs first, then scale. Interested in HNSW + compressed IVF for storage efficiency.

Performance targets: p95 end-to-end query latency <=150ms for top-10 reranked results in NA region; throughput target 200 qps steady with spikes to 1k qps during market open. Cost target: <$0.02/query avg (embeddings + rerank).

Model preferences & routing: prefer open/Redwood-verified embedder (1536-dim) + small cross-encoder reranker on dedicated GPU pool. Need automatic fallback to cheaper variant during capacity constraints. Multi-region read replicas: NA primary, EU copy for EU clients with residency enforcement.

Security/compliance: must support customer-managed KMS (HSM-backed keys), audit logs for all inference calls, SSO via SAML, data retention controls (7 years archival), and contractual data residency for EU clients. Air-gap not required but they will evaluate on-prem later for certain high-sensitivity clients.

Operational needs: deterministic performance (dedicated capacity), transparent per-token/per-query cost breakdown, rollouts (canary for reranker), and quality monitoring tied to a saved prompt set. They require exportable eval reports and anchors for regression alerts.

POC plan: 1) ingest 30M doc subset, build vector index (compare HNSW vs IVF-PQ), 2) run 2 embedder+reranker combos, 3) measure p50/p95 latencies, throughput, and cost per query, 4) validate KMS integration and VPC peering, 5) produce runbook for scaling to 500M vectors.

Quotes / call snippets: "Cant risk leakage — raw docs must never leave our VPC unencrypted, keys we control" (CTO). "Were sensitive to per-query economics; moving from batch to interactive search doubled costs last year" (Head of Ops).

Decision drivers: performance SLAs, clear unit economics for 500M+ vectors, enterprise security (KMS + residency), and ability to run a predictable dedicated cluster with autoscale/burst.

Next steps (short): run 2-week POC on dedicated nodes (Redwood lab), provide KMS architecture diagram, finalize pricing for 3 scale points (30M / 200M / 500M vectors).

Lead AE notes (Sanjay): keep commercial flexible — exec sponsor wants an annual commit if SLA numbers validated. Legal already flagged residency addendum.
